rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for similarity or resemblance.

example.english: The likeness between these two photos is very high; they really look alike.
example.traditional: 呢兩張相嘅相似度好高，真係幾似樣。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 zoeng1 soeng2 ge3 soeng1 ci5 dou6 hou2 gou1 zan1 hai6 gei2 ci5 joeng6

rows.note: Use this for a portrait or depicted image rather than abstract resemblance.

example.english: A likeness of a famous person is hanging in the museum.
example.traditional: 博物館入面掛咗一幅名人肖像。
example.jyutping: bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 min6 gwaa3 zo2 jat1 fuk1 ming4 jan4 ciu3 zoeng6
